page.notes: Greek words are uncertain at several points because the scan is faint, so they are marked [?] or illegible. The Greek lemma at the start of "Mos fuit" and the Epiphanius passage are the least certain. The Greek lemma at the head of the second paragraph is also doubtful. The opening verse is italic and is treated as one stanza. The catchword "hoc" stands alone below the last line and is not repeated in the text.
